validation_queries.description: Device sampling is limited to a single GPU agent
validation_queries.error_message: --gpus=0 did not limit PMC sampling to exactly one GPU agent
validation_queries.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT info.agent_id) as count FROM {table_name} event JOIN rocpd_info_pmc info ON event.pmc_id = info.id WHERE info.target_arch = 'GPU'
